message.reasoning_content: need to determine crimes based on facts: illegal possession of firearms (bird gun and hunting rifle) which are firearms using gunpowder. Chinese criminal law: illegal possession of firearms is a crime under "非法持有枪支、弹药罪" (illegal possession of firearms and ammunition). Also possibly "非法买卖枪支、弹药罪" but here only possession. So the crime is "非法持有枪支、弹药罪". Also maybe "非法携带枪支罪"? But they were found in possession, not necessarily carrying. The law: Article 122 of Criminal Law: illegal possession of firearms, ammunition, explosives, etc. So answer: [罪名]非法持有枪支、弹药罪<eoa>
